records.text: The Turning Point USA investor meeting in Aspen took place from August 15 through August 17, about three weeks before Charlie Kirk died.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: This investor meeting, what she's referring to, just so you know, took place from August 15th to the 17th in Aspen. So this was a mere three weeks before.

verification.notes: Transcript context supplies precise August 15 through 17 Aspen meeting dates, but a live search found no authoritative public event record confirming those dates. The approximate interval to September 10 is arithmetic, but the underlying private donor-event dates remain unverified.

records.text: Multiple Turning Point USA donors said Charlie Kirk never stated in Aspen that Erika Kirk should become CEO and chairman if something happened to him, either onstage or at the smaller dinner.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #2 (Ep xi8SYJTUXPM)

appearances.snippet: I spoke to multiple donors who tell me that the audio that you released of Charlie Kirk saying, I appoint Erika Kirk. ... To be the CEO and chairman if something ever happens to me. They claim that he never said that in Aspen. ... They claim Erika actually was in Aspen, even though she didn't attend the event and that Charlie definitively never said that on stage, nor did he say it in a smaller dinner that took place with about 10 to 12 people is my understanding.

verification.notes: Transcript context attributes the denial to unnamed TPUSA donors said to have attended a private Aspen meeting and dinner. Current searches found the disputed audio and TPUSA succession claims but no on-record donor testimony or complete authenticated event recording proving what was or was not said in either setting.

records.text: The recording presented as Charlie Kirk appointing Erika Kirk CEO did not occur at the Aspen event.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #4 (Ep k1b1NDCrNFs)

appearances.snippet: You got donors who say that the Charlie (Charlie Kirk) voice saying that he appoints Erika (Erika Kirk) as CEO, which you guys allege took place at the Aspen events. Donors that were in attendance say that that did not happen. Blake (Blake Neff), what say you? Can you please drop the video?

verification.notes: Later reporting says a full recording from the Aspen donor retreat was reviewed and captures Charlie Kirk naming Erika as his preferred successor, and later public video included the statement. That directly contradicts the anonymous report that the event did not occur. Because the original full retreat recording is not openly available and authenticity disputes remain, confidence is medium rather than high.
